summary: Military aircraft to conduct high-energy manoeuvres up to 5,000 ft within 5 nautical miles of Glaisdale.
text:
AIR EXER. 1 MIL ACFT WILL CONDUCT HIGH ENERGY MANOEUVRES IN 
SUPPORT OF GROUND OPS WI 5NM RADIUS OF 542625N 0005101W (GLAISDALE). 
ACFT MAY OPR AT SPEEDS OF UP TO 450 KT IAS AND MAY NOT BE ABLE TO 
COMPLY WITH RAC. FOR FURTHER INFO AIC Y007/2023 REFERS. FOR INFO 
07517 258611. AR-2026-10181/01.
